changelog:
- Initial public release of "eb-dev-workflow" (v1.0.0), a master orchestrator for the autonomous development lifecycle.
- Coordinates all phases: idea intake, PRD, clarification, issue breakdown, architecture, QA planning, development, automated testing, code review, pull request management, and issue closure.
- Delegates to existing specialized skills (PRD creation, issue generation, architecture design, code review); directly manages QA planning, testing, and PR flow.
- Triggers automatically when the user mentions starting new features, planning, or asks about next development steps.
- Provides a session start protocol for transparent workflow state and user confirmation.
summary: Master orchestrator for the full autonomous development lifecycle. Use this skill whenever the user mentions starting a new feature, has an idea to implement...
